args.name: Measure candidate shelter materials
args.function: Physically examine accessible loose materials or owned samples and report measured properties needed to assess the learned shelter recipe.
args.conditions: Nearby fallen branches have visible stock but observation returned no dimensions. The shelter requires 20 rigid rods of specified diameter and lengths, 30 metres of strand, and measured volumes of dry covering and bedding. No suitable material has yet been established.
args.inputs: An accessible source or owned sample selected by exact identity; any necessary measuring tools must actually be available. Methods and tool requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify realistic time, effort, tools and any sample consumption. Do not consume or reserve material without an explicit action.
args.effects: Return only properties actually measured, such as rod length and diameter, usable strand length, or mass, moisture and stem characteristics relevant to volume. Identify unmeasurable properties and unsuitable samples honestly; do not create material or imply construction.

candidates.function: Build a hand-lashed low A-frame thatched shelter for one reclining person from rods, binding, dry stems and bedding; inspect, resume, repair, dismantle or cancel it.
candidates.costs: Study 4 rounds. Every paid round is 1 energy. build: x, y in reach, orientation (open end faces local -y), materials as own items with role rod, binding, thatch or bedding; a measured shortfall is refused at no cost. Round 1 inspects site and items; a failure reserves nothing. Then 9 rounds: legs, ridge and rails, battens twice, covering four times, bedding with final inspection. build naming the shelter resumes. inspect (anyone, site or shelter): 1 round. repair: replacements for defects, a round per metre of binding or 0.05 m3 of covering or bedding. dismantle (empty): 2 rounds. cancel: free. Gathering and travel are extra.
candidates.effects: Recipe: 20 rigid wood rods (diameter 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; legs 0.82 m, others 0.9 m long), at least 30 m of strand (vine 3 m, reed 1.8 m a unit), 0.26 m3 of dry thin-stem covering and 0.1 m3 of dry bedding, volumes from mass, water share (dry at most 0.4) and the stem law; dry grass has none. Inputs become one shelter, 1.6 x 0.8 m under a 0.6 m ridge. Complete only after the final inspection. Occupant: one body wholly on the floor that came in by the open end; a second body voids protection. Rated to rain 5 mm/h (index 1 brings 0.033 mm/h) and wind 5 m/s (index 1 read as 5 m/s): rain on the body x(1 - 0.8 x cover), wind chill x(1 - 0.5 x cover x shelter not facing the wind with its open end), dry bedding halves the ground share (0.25) of cooling; air temperature unchanged. Covering holds rain up to its dry mass, leaks through gaps, dries. Strands and covering wear 0.001 a round, 0.002 in rain or wind; below 0.75 gaps open, below 0.5 lashings fail and the frame collapses. Cancel returns unbuilt inputs once; death stops the work and drops them where the person died; built parts stay until dismantled, returned with condition and water. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
candidates.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general material examination and measurement operation. Related functions were searched and the exact probe and construct-weather-shelter contracts reviewed. Probe supports observation and press/wet/heat trials, not calibrated dimensional, mass or moisture measurement; its observation already returned stock without dimensions. Shelter inspection checks named construction inputs but does not provide the requested independent measurement of accessible source specimens. Reuse their observation, reference validation and recipe-checking code where applicable; add only physical measurement and its evidence records. No currently suitable material or measuring equipment is established.\",\"specification\":\"Current-conversation development handoff: implement examine-material, available for any applicable actor, with exact target ID, optional physically distinguishable specimen selector, requested properties, mode (inspect or measure), and exact reference/tool IDs. Target may be accessible exposed loose material or an owned sample; do not bind the operation to Kai or to branches. Resolve references and interaction range at execution, requiring a safely accessible specimen and any physically necessary handling permission. A source stock count is not a specimen dimension, mass or usable length. Do not disclose hidden source contents or assume all units match a sampled unit. An unresolved specimen returns an explicit limitation rather than a fabricated measurement.\\nSmallest executable version: one-round nondestructive examination of one accessible specimen, with calibrated length and diameter measurement only when an appropriate real graduated tool or previously calibrated physical reference is supplied. Tool resolution, reach, ability to expose both ends, deformation and measurement uncertainty limit the result. Without such a reference, report only directly observable qualitative traits and mark metric dimensions unavailable; do not infer metres from screen coordinates, body size or stock. Measuring a strand requires accessible ends and laying it out without damaging it; inaccessible or entangled portions are unmeasured. Missing instruments are physical prerequisites, not permanently disqualifying mechanisms: return them as unmet requirements to this handoff, without granting or automatically crafting any.\\nOptional properties use the same operation only where supported by actual instruments and implemented methods: mass requires a functioning calibrated balance and real tare; volume requires measured dimensions plus a stated applicable geometric method, or an actually available volumetric apparatus. Visual dryness is not a numeric water share, appearance is not a strength test, and bulk envelope volume is not solid volume. Moisture percentage and quantitative rigidity remain unavailable absent a supported measurement procedure. Do not silently add destructive drying, soaking, breaking or cutting. Any future destructive procedure must require a separate explicit invocation declaring sample quantity, apparatus, energy, duration and conserved residues. Reuse the existing construct-weather-shelter@1 stem-law calculation and suitability checks only with genuinely measured required inputs and their uncertainty; otherwise mark recipe suitability undetermined, or report a specific measured failure. Do not invent missing law coefficients, infer dry-grass volume from stock, or assert that a whole source meets the recipe from one sample. Shelter inspection/build remains construct-weather-shelter.\\nCosts: study is 2 simulation rounds at 0.2 energy per completed study round, separately for each learner. Each inspect or single-property measure invocation takes 1 active simulation round and 0.2 energy, with ordinary hunger/exposure continuing. Travel, repositioning and additional specimens/properties require separate actions and their actual costs. Nondestructive examination consumes zero material and no fuel and reserves or transfers no source stock. Validate missing targets, tools and accessibility before paid work; invalid requests cost nothing. If actual access proves insufficient during work, charge the effort actually performed and return only the observed limitation. Tools must be present and serviceable; do not create, calibrate or repair them implicitly.\\nPersist work identity, target revision, specimen selector, property, tool/reference identities and completed effort. Before completion, interruption pauses without a completed measurement; resume rechecks access and unchanged specimen/reference state. Changed state invalidates incompatible partial work and must be reported. Cancel or death stops unfinished work without a result or refund of spent time/energy; no unconsumed stock was reserved and no material refund is created. Never debit a round twice or duplicate an output on resume. No continuing physical process or maintenance is introduced by inspection itself; tool condition is checked under its existing rules.\\nThe real product is a measured-evidence record, not an item or constructed shelter: exact source/item and specimen references, actor, event/time, method, tool and calibration provenance, value and units where measured, resolution/uncertainty, conditions, scope and limitations. Cite construct-weather-shelter for any derived recipe comparison, preserving partial or indeterminate verdicts. Subsequent weather, decay, movement or deformation can stale the record; it never permanently certifies a material. Record reused probe observation/reference-validation and shelter calculation code in implementation provenance rather than claiming reinvention. Execute these validation, accounting and output rules in code, not repeated model review. Review/development waiting advances no world time; registration grants neither tools nor personal mastery. No protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions are modified.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"Requests, registration, querying and study grant no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed personally applicable examination may qualify through verified information gain, including a genuinely informative failure, only under the existing experience mechanism. Emit evidence, not a direct reward-account mutation. If that mechanism needs a handler, hand off a bounded eligibility rule: at most one modest information-gain contribution per materially distinct specimen/property/condition, deduplicated across probe, shelter inspection and this operation; repeated unchanged readings receive none. Apply the existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 with a rolling 10-round cooldown for the same functional finding and existing account caps; do not accumulate stored reward while paused. Familiar legitimate measurement practice may sustain modest benefit only when actual work occurs and existing capped practice rules permit it. No physical comfort or nutrition benefit is produced; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and nutrition is unaffected by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable start, handling/measurement, pause, cancellation, limitation and completed-reading events with reusable metadata: operation, exact target/specimen, actor, property, tool/reference, progress, status, units, uncertainty and evidence ID. Show handling or a measurement overlay only while the actor actually acts within reach; show a scale or instrument only when physically present. A completed label displays only measured properties and qualified derived comparisons. Qualitative observations remain labelled qualitative; missing tools, interrupted work and inaccessible material display incomplete/unavailable states, never a successful numerical measurement or shelter-success visual. No stock, object geometry or shelter state changes merely because a record is produced.\"}]}"}
